title: RTP Player: Fix of opening of multiple dialogs
description:
It should not be possible to open same dialog twice because of race
condition. Opening of all singleton telephone dialogs is guarded by
mutex now.
replace/add/remove streams is guarded by mutex to avoid race conditions
during changing count of streams.

Hello @j.novak 

I've found one way to trigger a crash. 

1 - Open the file SIP_CALL_RTP_G711 downloaded from Wireshark's SampleCaptures page.

2 - Choose the menu item Telephone -> RTP Streams to open the 'RTP Streams' dialog. 

3 - In the 'RTP Streams' select all three streams.

4 - Click the [Play Streams] "button".  This will open a drop-down list.

5 - From the drop-down list select 'Add to playlist'

6 - The 'RTP Player' will appear.  In the 'RTP Player' click on the [>] button to start playing the audio.

7 - WHILE THE AUDIO IS PLAYING, move focus back to the 'RTP Streams' dialog and repeat steps 4 and 5 above (the 3 streams should still be selected).

8 - Wireshark crashes.

Using the steps above I've replicated crashes on both a Windows 8.1 system and macOS v10.15.7 system using recent automated releases ('Wireshark-win64-3.5.0rc0-1489-gd2bf2af308d4.exe' on Windows and 'Wireshark 3.5.0rc0-1486-g0b8522752895 Intel 64.dmg' on the macOS).
